title: scriptc compiles ordinary TypeScript to native binaries with no Node and no V8 inside, from Vercel

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Script C compiles ordinary TypeScript to native binaries with no node and no V8 inside from Versel Labs. Real TSC does the type checking, then lowering runs through a typed to LLVM or C. It reports statement by statement what compiles statically and names each blocker with an error code. Zero runtime holds for the static path only. NPM dependencies need dynamic mode which embeds quick.js. JS.
